step1_analysis.description: A dynamic buffer or level-shifter sub-circuit used to drive a locally bootstrapped switch. It utilizes cascode transistors to prevent gate dielectric overstress, enabling reliable rail-to-rail signal switching in low-voltage applications.

paper_reference.title: Very Low-Voltage Digital-Audio Modulator with 88-dB Dynamic Range Using Local Switch Bootstrapping

dynamic_range.description: Dynamic range of the full delta-sigma modulator

sky130_expected.calculation: System-level metric depending on OSR and modulator order.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With an OSR of 100 and a 3rd-order loop, 88+ dB is highly achievable in the sky130 process.

peak_snr.description: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of the modulator

sky130_expected.calculation: Typically 1-2 dB below the Dynamic Range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales similarly to DR; thermal noise floor in sky130 will dictate the exact peak.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by switch linearity and op-amp distortion.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bootstrapped switches in sky130 provide excellent constant Vgs, maintaining high linearity for SNDR.
Standard audio bandwidth target remains unchanged across technology nodes.

total_power.description: Total power consumption of the modulator

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. At 1.8V, power will be higher than the 1V reported.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Operating at 1.8V in sky130 instead of 1V will increase both dynamic (CV^2f) and static power.

propagation_delay.description: Delay from input (LABEL_NET_1) to output (N1) for the sub-block

sky130_expected.calculation: t_pd ~ (Cload * VDD) / I_on. I_on ~ 270u * (5/0.5) * (1.8-0.4)^2 / 2 ~ 2.6mA. Cload=10fF. t_pd ~ 10f * 1.8 / 2.6m ~ 7ps. Add parasitic delay.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast switching is expected due to the large W/L (5u/0.5u) of the transistors and small local load.

v_max.description: Maximum output high voltage of the driver

sky130_expected.calculation: Pulled to VDD by PMOS XM1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS XM1 pulls N1 fully to VDD when N0 is discharged to 0V.

v_min.description: Minimum output low voltage of the driver

sky130_expected.calculation: Pulled to GND by NMOS stack (XM5, XM2).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS stack is strong, but subthreshold leakage from the PMOS (if N0 is only at VDD-Vth) might slightly raise the floor.

step3_testbench.description: Transient and DC operating point analysis to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, output voltage levels, and static power of the switch driver sub-block.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bootstrapped Switch Driver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VDD LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND N2 0 0
VN3 N3 0 1.8

* Inputs: IN and IN_bar
VIN LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4.9n 10n)
VIN_BAR LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4.9n 10n)
VPRE LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4.9n 10n)

Cload N1 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 20n
meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(N1) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.36 fall=1
meas tran t_pd trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran v_max max v(N1)
meas tran v_min min v(N1)

op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
quit
.endc
